scope: New ordinary-LoRA sequential experiment using exactly the frozen prototype replay samples selected by the old CL-LoRA prototype group; old four-group results remain immutable
stage_A: Fully retrain from original base; do not copy old plain or CL checkpoints
later_stages: Load the immediately preceding stage checkpoint of this new plain_prototype group only; reset stage optimizer/schedule as in the original protocol

model.name: pi05_base
model.freeze_filter: Same balanced filter as old plain LoRA; ordinary LoRA A/B and the same lightweight heads trainable
model.dtype: bfloat16 model configuration; native optimizer precision retained

training.current_loss: Native ordinary model.compute_loss with the ordinary RNG split retained
training.replay_loss: Independent RNG replay flow-matching loss added to current loss on scheduled steps; no extra optimizer step

replay.source: Frozen old CL-LoRA prototype buffers, read-only; not regenerated by the new ordinary model
replay.episode_selection: First10 in each original training repo; same source episode IDs as old prototype/uniform experiment
replay.task_sampling: round_robin; one old task per replay update
replay.normalization: Each replay task uses the frozen buffer's own old-task norm assets; never current-task statistics
replay.interpretation: Fixed-memory control to compare ordinary LoRA with the original CL-LoRA replay groups, not an end-to-end ordinary-model prototype selector

evaluation.after_each_stage: Evaluate all learned tasks, triangular10 sessions/500 rollouts
evaluation.selection: Final stageD fixed checkpoint; no evaluation-driven buffer or checkpoint tuning
